india_grid_weighted_average.source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database Version 21.0; FY2024-25 weighted-average grid emission rate including renewable energy and captive generation, excluding imports
india_grid_weighted_average.note: Use the factor applicable to the reporting period and disclose the selected CEA variant. This V1 registry uses the all-India weighted-average grid rate for location-based Scope 2 estimation.
